name: The Basilisk's Bite
label: Quest
description: The Basilisk's Bite: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, friend. These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.
I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.
Retrieve ten of their brains for me, friend. The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned with the requested organs?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is wondrous, friend! My offering to you is a taste of the inner workings of the redstone basilisk.
Should the compound be to your liking, more can always be made... For a price.
